english.title: Motor salvage operator not registered
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), carried on business as a motor salvage operator in the area of a local authority, namely **(..SPECIFY..), without being registered for the area by the local authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings under this Section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(ii) See section 1(2) for clarification of "carries on business as a motor salvage operator".
(iii) "Registered" means registered in accordance with the provisions of Part 1 of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001 in a register established and maintained by a local authority under section 2 of the Act.
(iv) See section 16 for other interpretations of Part 1 of the Act.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
